explainer_reply:
Looking at these examples, I notice the marked tokens almost always come right after the word "great" or its variants:
- "Great attention", "great skill", "Great Ice", "great difficulty", "great day", "great design", "Great WIRED", "Great House", "Great Falls", "Great Composers"
- Comparative forms: "greater cost", "Greater Threat", "greater Greece", "greatest care", "greater decrease"
- Synonyms/related words: "Big Easy", "major migrations of", "terrible mistake", and even the Chinese character 大 (meaning "big/great")
- The highest activations (8-9) are all directly after "Great", while the few exceptions (Showboats, East Coast, Talk Page) have very low activations

[EXPLANATION]: Tokens that immediately follow the word "great" (including its comparative forms "greater"/"greatest" and close synonyms like "big" or "major"), typically the noun being modified by "great".
